name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: June Week 2 - Branding
description: Practice words for branding and consistent design.

words.definition: The style and identity of a product or group.
words.example: The brand used the same colors on the poster and game screen.

words.definition: A symbol or design that represents a group or idea.
words.example: The logo represented the project with one simple symbol.
The palette used blue, green, and white.

words.definition: The style and arrangement of text.
words.example: The typography made the title easy to read.

words.definition: Keeping choices the same across a design.
words.example: Consistency kept the same logo size on each slide.

words.definition: Helpful comments about how to improve.
words.example: Feedback told the student to make the title larger.

words.definition: A changed version made after review.
words.example: The revision changed the colors after peer review.
